report.scope: Original 2017 standard core, balanced boards, normal Blight, solo and stated introductory alternatives. Expansions/promos, adversaries/scenarios, thematic maps and optional difficulty/scoring excluded. Later-product FAQ examples do not extend scope.
report.primary_source_hierarchy: Current official 32-page CORE plus applicable linked Living FAQ, primary printed core faces/panels; publisher B&C membership prose and symbol legend plus designer corrections establish component scope. Catalog/module metadata is locator only.

checked_groups.name: Complete original-core book and candidate
checked_groups.scope: Read entire candidate and all 32 extracted pages, including index/reference; standard balanced-board procedures retained; excluded modules recognized without requiring them.

checked_groups.name: Setup, components, introductory alternatives and solo
checked_groups.scope: Deck randomization/counts/dividers, initial Explore, board arrangement, Blight box versus pool, 13 disks, panel setup ties/same land, initial +1 correction, progression Major Forget, solo other-Spirit exception, multiple-role scaling.

checked_groups.name: Phase order, Growth, Presence and track procedures
checked_groups.scope: Simultaneous players and complete Spirit Phase barrier; pick-one/default and mandatory effects/explicit costs; Green Always exception; ordered multiple gains/placements; Add/reposition versus Move; track highest numbers versus additive elements and Reclaim One; Fast/Slow/Time Passes.

checked_groups.name: Invader cards, Ravage, Build and Explore
checked_groups.scope: Land eligibility list per card; stage III interleaving; Coastal stage II and ignored Escalation; Invader stats, simultaneous land/Dahan Damage, efficient allocation, Defend and counterattack; Build branch more Towns; Explore sources and one Explorer; empty deck loss only when draw needed.

checked_groups.name: Power rules, Elements, targets, internal Range, choices and timing
checked_groups.scope: Whole-Power fewer-Elements choice, met thresholds, Instead, First/Before and attribute timing; mandatory versus up-to; or adjacency; no-op legal targeting versus foregoing; shared Range origin and bonus actor; numeric Range vs Presence source/target restrictions.

checked_groups.name: Gaining, Forgetting, transfers and extra plays
checked_groups.scope: Four-card gains/shared deck reshuffle/discards; own hand/discard/play Forget including new Major; immediately lost Elements/unused activation, resolved effects persist; each Major separate Forget; transfer not gain; Entwined actor and draw, gifts only hand; outside-step card plays and speed.

checked_groups.name: Damage, Health, Destroy, Remove, Replace and movement
checked_groups.scope: Damage accumulation, instant destruction, marked Damage versus Health, diminished Health destruction destination; destruction Fear; replacement retained damage and simultaneous selection; Defend scope; Gather/Push adjacency and mandatory/up-to; generic Move self legal; no island/Ocean movement absent permission.

checked_groups.name: Repeats
checked_groups.scope: Card use vs play/Elements; current thresholds; carried modifications and most recently set speed; immediate repeat timing; explicit repeat location; costs free Gift versus paid Powerstorm; deferred card selection; different-card threshold; no repeat chaining.

checked_groups.name: Fear, Blight, geography and outcomes
checked_groups.scope: Fear pool cycles/dividers, earned order/current Terror/no lookahead and appended new cards; each-player versus mixed action structure; generic Presence requirement; no pooling independent health-removal allowances; Presence/Sacred Sites/adjacency/coasts; Blight destroy per Spirit, one cascade/revisit, simultaneous shortage flip/refill/no +1 on flip, removal return; finish action tree and sacrifice checks.

checked_groups.name: All eight original Spirits: Special Rules, Growth, setup and Innates
checked_groups.scope: Independently read every front/back panel at native size. Checked all printed procedural branches: Lightning optional City instead and Fast allowance; River Sacred Site and Instead; Earth free eligible Repeat and Defend; Shadows payment/source and mandatory Gather; Green Always/optional group/temporary play/destroyed Presence/optional skip/innate Repeats; Thunderspeaker per-Dahan accompany/trigger loss/Fast attribute; Ocean any-Ocean vs Coastal placement, each-Ocean movement, land restriction/Drown/energy/optional innate replacement; Bringer original Any tracks, no-damage replacement/single-use/Element grant/Fear flip. Numeric and target payloads may remain on components as authorized.

checked_groups.name: Printed core cards, unique exceptions and trigger interactions
checked_groups.scope: Independently viewed full 31 in-scope card faces and compared each candidate-specific procedure. Checked protection distinctions; Words simultaneous Damage; Wrap First/zero Move; Blazing restored Presence/Range/mandatory addition/that land; Trees moving per-Dahan Defend; Powerstorm payments; Entwined draw/gift; Tidal Boon user/optional nonadjacent Coastal destination; Song conditional; Dissolve Before/Push destinations; Poisoned self-Blight; Tsunami per-land Fear; Vengeance after-action/nonrecursive and Bringer ownership; Scapegoats per-land action and updated Dahan Enheartened.

report.independence_statement: New independent reviewer with no repair authorship. Read only exact candidate, assigned manifests and their authoritative source/provenance materials. Did not inspect question banks, answer keys, asked-fact maps, coverage reviews, reader outputs, grades, prior audits, repair history, other agents' outputs or runtime logs. Did not follow manifest identity_proof or peer-provenance-ledger references. Did not read or execute community module code or inspect alternate states/aspects. Summary treated as review object, never authority. No delegation and no git mutations.
limitations: This is a source accuracy/completeness audit of the stated original-core scope, not a demand to reproduce component numerical payloads or enumerate arbitrary numeric/card combinations. Component-specific payloads remain available on the panels/cards as the candidate directs.

Transport HTML and duplicate/cropped/context-only records were reconciled to fully read prose or full primary visuals rather than being falsely claimed as completely read raw HTML. Full B&C gameplay is excluded; only its page-6 membership legend is authoritative here.
Dated physical photograph corroborates identity/layout of the original eight only; exact fine-print comparison used all 16 original-resolution facsimiles and current official text.
No unresolved rules concern remains after these comparisons.
